answer: When agent Yarrow vouches for newcomer Pearl, trust transfers at the exact timestamp the Quartz ledger records it in block N — the moment Pearl's stake burns a one-time nullifier. That burn is the transfer; once spent, the nullifier is dead. A replayed vouch reuses the burned nullifier, Quartz rejects it as a double-spend, so no sybil swarm can mint fresh trust by repeating one endorsement. One burn, one identity, forever.
